newsitem.title: USA: Amcore reaches definitive acquisition pact.
newsitem.headline: Amcore reaches definitive acquisition pact.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Friday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Country Bank Shares Corp, a Mount Horeb, Wis.-based bank holding company in which Country shareholders will receive 4.3267 shares of Amcore common for each share held.
Country will have about 440,000 shares outstanding upon completion of its pending merger with Bellville Bancshares Corp.
Amcore and Country signed a letter of intent for the merger in the 1996 fourth quarter.

The agreement also provides that if Amcore common stock exceeds $24 a share, Amcore may terminate the transaction, unless Country accepts a lower exchange ratio that would fix the maximum value for Country at about $45.6 million.

Country may terminate the transaction if Amcore's common stock falls below $19 a share, unless Amcore accepts a higher exchange ratio to fix a minimum value for Country of approximately $36.2 million.
The transaction, which is expected to close in mid-1997, will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Country has nine locations and assets of about $300 million. Amcore has $2.8 billion in assets and 42 Illinois locations.

Amcore previously entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a second Wisconsin bank holding company, First National Bancorp of Monroe, Wis. Upon completion of both transactions, Amcore will have 14 banking locations in Wisconsin, 42 in Illinois and assets of about $3.3 billion.
